assumption: The user means database storage; clarification was pending during measurement. This change does not alter visual job-card size.

implementation.codec: Version-1 zlib dictionary plus base64 in existing TEXT; ORM returns the exact original JSON string.
implementation.dictionary_origin: Fixed public string literals from eligibility.py, skills.py, roles.py and v2.py, plus an empty ranking schema. Every skeleton string was blanked, number set to zero and boolean set to false; no candidate/job/profile values were retained. It is not regenerated from code at runtime.
implementation.preserved: Personalized scores, complete explanations, warnings, arbitrary JSON fields/types/Unicode/whitespace and hidden scoring caches; nine raw-SQL eligibility gates.
implementation.fallbacks: Short, invalid, oversized, reserved-name legacy collisions and insufficiently compressible values remain plain.
implementation.budget: The existing SQL planner accounts for at least the larger of encoded bytes and original logical UTF8 bytes n; shared 64MiB/day ledger and existing per-pass limits remain conservative.
implementation.existing_rows: Plain legacy rows remain readable and are compacted only when ordinary future insert/update paths write a suitable ranking. No automatic rewriting of existing rows.

independent_holdout.variation: Disjoint descriptions, ten title families, varying experience/degree/location/work mode, Hebrew text; dictionary fixed before evaluating holdout.
independent_holdout.roundtrip: All 240 original compact JSON strings roundtripped exactly; same fixture values populated both tables.

rejected_alternatives.ordinary_zlib_full_sql_summary: Increased physical table storage by about11% in the first synthetic fixture.
rejected_alternatives.ordinary_zlib_remainder_full_eligibility: Increased physical table storage by about45%.
rejected_alternatives.derived_reason_warning_omission: Reduced UTF8 bytes without reducing actual PostgreSQL table bytes.
rejected_alternatives.all_key_abbreviations: Measured about18% reduction but added a custom field mapping without outperforming the selected lossless codec.
rejected_alternatives.template_trained_dictionary: Large apparent saving was overfitted to one full synthetic template; not selected.
rejected_alternatives.index_removal: Six scalar indexes were about2.8% of a fresh5000-row table, and global engine invalidation still uses its scalar index; no index changes proposed.

verification.coverage: Exact-string/unit bounds/corruption/bomb handling; real SQLite and PostgreSQL persistence; SQL diagnostics; cached hidden ranking restoration without skills recomputation; legacy+encoded coexistence; owner isolation and no extra reads; existing v2/visibility/UI contracts and PostgreSQL canonical migrations.
verification.full_suite: Not rerun by this specialist; parent owns broader integration gates.

limits: Synthetic storage measurements are not production database usage or proof that a future catalog fits a service quota.
Savings depend on content and PostgreSQL page/TOAST compression; raw JSON byte ratios are not physical disk savings.
No general30% claim: actual full workload saved14.89% of database storage and mixed holdout saved16.83% of ranking-table storage.
Local timing changes must not be attributed causally to compression; no full-catalog ranking-throughput claim.
Existing legacy archives and historical retained tables may add storage beyond this fresh synthetic schema.
